items.title: Pay therapy invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: Invoice date (start of period) is 18.11.2026 (Wednesday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (the invoice date) is not counted, so the 21-day period starts on 19.11.2026. Counting 21 days from there (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB), the period ends on 09.12.2026 (18.11.2026 + 21 days = 09.12.2026; since 21 days = exactly 3 weeks, this also falls on a Wednesday). This is a payment owed to a private company in NRW; 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
